_doc: The hero road list (MAP_REPAIR.md 'Hero roads', owner 2026-11-10: the CP circles and radials, Janpath, the Lutyens avenues and roundabouts, the garden edges). Rule R-HERO-01 checks that every road listed here that is in the baked stage has a spec file harness/data/hero_roads/<id>.json; until it has one, the class defaults apply. Nothing on a listed road is ever repaired automatically (tools/bake/repair/bounds.ts). A road is found by its OSM street names (osmNames) or, when it has no name, by its OSM way ids (osmWays, read from the pilot extract of 2026-11-11). Roads outside the stage being baked are skipped.
